bag.Name: Sturdy Pack
bag.Blurb: Double stitched. Holds a good day's haul.

bag.Name: Miner's Rucksack
bag.Blurb: Iron-ribbed so the rocks don't poke through.

bag.Name: Reinforced Hauler
bag.Blurb: Gold buckles. Very fancy. Very roomy.

bag.Name: Dwarven Packframe
bag.Blurb: A proper dwarf design, with a Mythril frame.

bag.Name: Dragonhide Pack
bag.Blurb: Fireproof, and it still smells a bit of dragon.

bag.Name: Bottomless Bag
bag.Blurb: I've never found the bottom. Don't climb in.

bag.Name: Void Pouch
bag.Blurb: Bigger on the inside. Much bigger.

bag.Name: Celestial Vault
bag.Blurb: Woven from sky-thread. The finest bag in the land.

Lion.Blurb: King of the savanna, with a golden mane.

Unicorn.Blurb: A shimmering unicorn with a rainbow mane.

Warrior Ant.Blurb: Jaws like a bear trap. Grabs a foe and slams it into the dirt.

Fox.Blurb: A clever fox with a big bushy tail.

Abyssal Hydra.Blurb: Three heads, three bites, no mercy.

Owl.Blurb: A wise snowy owl. Grown owls can fly you.

Widow Spider.Blurb: Shoots webs that pin and poison. Eight legs, no mercy.

Dragon.Blurb: A real dragon. The fastest thing in the sky.

Ant Queen.Blurb: Mother of the colony. Buzzes through the sky and sends her brood to fight.

Void Squid.Blurb: Swims through the air like it's the deep sea. Inks its enemies.

Bunny.Blurb: Hops everywhere. Rides in great bounds.

Griffin.Blurb: Half eagle, half lion. Soars through the sky.

Wolf.Blurb: A loyal grey wolf. Fast on its feet.

Hedwig.Blurb: A legendary snowy owl. Nothing on land or in the sky comes close.

Void Amphiptere.Blurb: A winged serpent of the Void. Nothing flies faster.

Phoenix Flame.Description: Fierce burns, and goblins that die burning explode in a firestorm that hits everything nearby.

Soul Harvest.Description: Every kill reaps a soul (up to 10). Each soul adds +5% damage. Souls fade 20s after your last kill.

Seismic.Description: Swings send a tremor through the rock: other nodes within 9 studs take 40% of the hit.

Blizzard.Description: Every 6th hit calls a blizzard: everything nearby takes 70% damage, freezes solid for 1.5s and stays chilled.

Honed.Description: A well-kept edge: +15% power and 10% more ore.

Sharpness.Description: A keener edge: every hit deals 20% more damage.

King's Ransom.Description: 5% chance a broken node hides a king's hoard worth 30x the ore. +15% power.

Scavenger.Description: Picks every scrap out of the rubble: each broken node drops 1 extra ore.

Echo Strike.Description: Every 3rd swing echoes: it hits a second time a moment later.

Singularity.Description: +40% power. Every 6th swing opens a black hole that grinds every node within 18 studs for 2 seconds.

Chain Reaction.Description: Broken nodes burst, hitting every node within 10 studs for 40% of their health. Bursts can chain.

Veinseeker.Description: 30% chance a broken node cracks open the next vein too: the nearest node takes half its health.

Cataclysm.Description: +50% power. Every 10th swing the ground erupts: every node within 30 studs takes 5x power.

Corrosion.Description: Each hit eats into the goblin's hide: +6% damage taken from you per hit, up to +48%, for 5 seconds.

Venom.Description: Poisons goblins for 5 seconds. Poisoned goblins take 15% more damage from you.

Excavator.Description: Digs wide: every node within 7 studs of your swing takes 60% of the hit as well.

Regrowth.Description: Nodes you break grow back twice as fast. +10% power.

Shatter.Description: 12% chance for a swing to shatter the node outright, however tough it is.

Meteor.Description: 15% chance a meteor crashes down on the target: 120% damage to everything nearby, setting it ablaze.

Midas Touch.Description: Every node you break also pays you gold: a third of its ore's worth, straight to your pocket.

Aurum.Description: Everything you touch turns to gold: +30% power, 75% more ore, and every node pays its full ore worth in gold.

Eternity.Description: +60% power, and nodes you break grow back almost at once (90% faster).

Starfall.Description: Every 8th node you break calls down a falling star that smashes another node nearby for you. +20% power.

Motherlode.Description: 10% chance a broken node erupts with 4x the ore.

Dusk Reaper.Description: Every kill heals you 15% of your max health and unleashes a shadow scythe that cuts down everything around.

Sun's Grace.Description: Every hit heals you 5. Every 3rd hit calls down a sunbeam that scorches all nearby goblins.

Godslayer.Description: Double damage to bosses. 25% chance to crit for 3x, and crits heal you 4% of your max health.

Lucky Strike.Description: 20% chance for a swing to hit 3x as hard.

Void Rift.Description: Every 5th hit tears open a rift that drags goblins in and grinds them for 2 seconds.

Judgment.Description: Holy light smites any goblin below 15% health outright. Bosses below 15% take +60% damage instead.

Echo.Description: Every 3rd hit rings out again a moment later for 70% damage.

Arcane Missile.Description: 30% chance to loose an arcane bolt at another goblin nearby for 60% damage.

Ragnarok.Description: The end of all things: every 5th hit, fire and lightning rain on up to 6 goblins nearby for 160% damage each, stunning and burning them.

Phantom Blades.Description: Every hit sends 3 spectral blades after other goblins nearby for 50% damage each. +20% damage.

Ambush.Description: The first blow on an unhurt goblin deals 75% more damage.

Greed.Description: Goblins you finish off with this weapon spill extra gold (a quarter of their max health).

Executioner.Description: Deals double damage to goblins below 30% health.

Cornucopia.Description: Broken nodes always drop double ore, with a 10% chance of 5x instead.

Bleed.Description: Opens wounds: goblins bleed every half second for 3 seconds.

Starfury.Description: Every 4th hit pulls down 6 falling stars around the target, each blasting nearby goblins for 75% damage.

Fire.Description: Sets goblins ablaze, burning them every half second for 3 seconds.

Molten Core.Description: +30% power, and every swing leaves the rock molten: it keeps melting for 50% of the hit, 4 times over 2s.

Brutality.Description: +10% damage, and 15% of hits stagger the goblin for half a second.

Frenzy.Description: Each hit within 2 seconds of the last adds +6% damage, stacking up to +60%.

Quake.Description: Every 4th hit slams the ground: 80% damage to all goblins nearby and a 1 second stun.

Alchemist.Description: 10% chance a broken node transmutes: it drops the next more valuable ore instead.

Prospector.Description: 20% chance a broken node drops double ore.

Ice.Description: Chills goblins for 3 seconds: they move and swing at half speed. +4 damage.

Chronoshift.Description: Hits slow time on goblins. Every 6th hit stops time around you for 3s: frozen goblins take +60% damage from you.

Treasure Hunter.Description: 4% chance a broken node holds a buried treasure chest worth 15x the ore.

Frostbite.Description: Chills like Ice, and hitting a goblin that's already chilled shatters the frost for +60% damage.

Eclipse.Description: Sun and Moon as one: 25% crits for 2.5x, 10% lifesteal, and every 3rd hit an eclipse beam blasts everything nearby.

Philosopher's Stone.Description: +40% power, 50% more ore, and 25% of nodes transmute two steps up into far more valuable ore.

Moon's Blessing.Description: 30% chance to crit for double damage. Steals back 15% of all damage dealt as health.

Gold Fever.Description: Every 20th node you break sets off Gold Fever: double ore and +30% power for 12 seconds.

Earthsplitter.Description: Every 5th swing splits the earth: a fissure 24 studs ahead hits every node in its path for 2.5x power.

Storm Caller.Description: 40% chance to call chain lightning through 5 goblins for 80% damage, stunning them.

Worldbreaker.Description: +75% power, every swing hits every node around you, and 6% of swings shatter what they hit.

Dragon's Breath.Description: Every 4th hit breathes a cone of dragonfire ahead of you: 110% damage and a fierce burn to all in it.

Bloodlust.Description: Kills heal 8% of your max health and give +25% damage for 4 seconds.

Blood Moon.Description: Steal 18% of damage back as health. While you're below half health, deal +60% damage.

Thunder.Description: 25% chance for lightning to jump to 3 nearby goblins for 60% damage, stunning them.

Vampiric.Description: Drinks 12% of all damage dealt back as health.

Gold Vein.Description: 15% chance a broken node pays out twice its ore's worth in gold.

Momentum.Description: Each swing within 2.5s of the last adds +6% power, stacking up to +48%.

Giantslayer.Description: +45% damage against bosses and anything with 500+ max health.

Gust.Description: Hits blast goblins back with a gale. Triple knockback, +10% damage.

Colossus.Perk: 20% less damage, can't be knocked back

Emperor.Perk: 10% of hits crit for double, kills drop 50% more coins

Tidecaller.Perk: Heal 3% of the damage you deal

Gnarlroot.Perk: Every 4th hit roots the target and bursts into thorns

Siegemaster.Perk: Every 6th hit sets off a bomb

Stormforged.Perk: Hits can call down chain lightning

Hexblade.Perk: Hits hex foes: +15% damage taken for 3 s

Juggernaut.Perk: 25% less damage, can't be knocked back

Hivewarden.Perk: Hits stick with honey, every 5th hit a swarm stings nearby foes

QueenBee.Perk: Hits stick with honey, 15% of hits call a royal swarm that stings every foe nearby

Tower Shield.Perk: Blocks from every side, but slow

Thousand-Leg Bulwark.Perk: Parries burst with venom, blocked hits bite back

Kragmaw's Skullwall.Perk: Parries burst out, blocked hits bite back

Colossus Bulwark.Perk: A wall of stone - blocks from every side

Grukk's Gilded Shield.Perk: Wide parry window, blocked hits sting back

Phylactery Ward.Perk: Parries release a wave of souls

Powderkeg Bulwark.Perk: Parries go off like a powder keg

Thunderwall.Perk: Blocks from every side, parries thunderclap

Imperial Aegis.Perk: The Emperor's own: parries burst in gold, blocked hits bite back

Tusked Aegis.Perk: Blocked hits are gored back, parries burst

Hexmirror Ward.Perk: A huge parry window, parries burst with hexfire

Grumhold's Wall.Perk: An iron wall - blocks from every side

Heartwood Aegis.Perk: Parries burst into thorns, blocked hits bite back

Honeycomb Bulwark.Perk: Parries splash sticky honey: everything nearby is hurt and slowed

Vespera's Royal Comb.Perk: Parries splash royal honey, blocked hits sting back

Items.Text: A witch has moved into a crooked little hut in the grove just east of the town plaza. Pay her 50,000 gold and she'll teach you magic.
Items.Title: Granny Hexley the Witch

Items.Text: Learning magic doesn't hand you a spell - you roll for it at her cauldron, like enchanting. Each brew costs 5,000 gold and 5 Crystals and replaces your spell. Auto-brew stops at the rarity you pick.
Items.Title: Brew your magic power

Items.Text: From Common Magic Missile, Firebolt and Healing Light up to Legendary Black Hole and Thunderstorm and the Mythic Starfall and Archmage's Wrath. Spell damage scales with your weapon.
Items.Title: 20 spells

Items.Text: Cast with G (R3 on a controller, or the Cast button on mobile) - rebind it in Keys. On a controller the Collection Book no longer has a default button; give it one in Keys if you want it.
Items.Title: Cast key
Blood Moon
Items.Text: A new world event: the sky turns red, packs of blood goblins hunt the town, and every monster drops triple gold. Blood goblins pay a bonus that grows with your weapon.

Items.Title: Arcane Surge
Items.Text: For 2 minutes, Rare and better enchants AND spells are 3x as likely. Run to the Enchanter's Altar and Granny Hexley's cauldron!

Items.Title: Fallen Stars
Items.Text: 8 stars crash down around town - follow the beams of light and gather them for gold and sky ore (Starmetal, Aetherium and more).

Items.Title: Goblin Caravan
Items.Text: A goblin loot wagon rolls round the edge of town with guards jumping off it. Smash it before it gets away - everyone who hit it shares the loot.

Items.Title: Pet Frenzy
Items.Text: Pets grow 4x as fast for 90 seconds - bring yours out!

Items.Title: Your Adventure (Stats)
Items.Text: A new Stats button (or press L) shows everything you've done: playtime, ore mined by type, monsters slain by kind, bosses beaten, gold earned and spent, your biggest hit, best spell and enchant, eggs hatched and more. The new counters start today.

Items.Title: Rootdeep, part 2
Items.Text: Finished Fennick's quest? Look up at the old stump - something green is growing. Meet Oakhollow the Tree Keeper behind Fennick's camp.

Items.Title: Grow the world-tree
Items.Text: Oakhollow's new questline, The Waking Tree, makes the tree grow with every step - your own tree, saved with your quest. Climb the root stair and the spiral up the trunk.

Items.Title: The Heartwood Hollow
Items.Text: A warm room inside the trunk, crawling with Barkbeetles and the huge Stagborer. Gather the amber tears and mine the new Heartamber ore.

Items.Title: The Beehive
Items.Text: A giant hive on the tree's great branch - Broodhollow kin. Honey Drones and Hive Guards dive and sting. Mine Royal Honeycomb.

Items.Title: Bumbleworth's Honeyworks
Items.Text: A new shop by Oakhollow, run by Bumbleworth the Beekeeper. Four new pickaxes with their own forms: Heartamber (amber shards, crystal shatter), Snapjaw (a giant flytrap), Hivequeen (ride a giant bee) and Galeleaf (ride a whirlwind). Unlocked by finishing The Waking Tree.

Items.Title: Hivewarden gear
Items.Text: Bumbleworth also sells the Hivewarden armor set (hits stick with honey, every 5th hit a swarm stings nearby foes), the Hivestinger Lance (a venomous stinger that pierces a line) and the Honeycomb Bulwark (parries splash sticky honey).

Items.Title: Rewards
Items.Text: 500,000 gold and the Crown of the World-Tree badge for waking the crown, plus 4 new creatures and 2 new ores for the Collection Book.

Items.Title: Vespera, the Hive Queen
Items.Text: A new raid boss in the royal cell on the Beehive (for players whose tree holds the Hive). She dives, spits honey and calls her swarm - in her last phase only the smoke pots keep it off you. Drops the Royal Hive armor set, Vespera's Royal Stinger and Vespera's Royal Comb.
Strike the War Gong in the Goblin Fort's War Hall to challenge the Warchief and his warband. Beat him for his gear - and the key to the Kingdom.
Items.Title: Kragmaw the Warchief

Items.Text: An endless raid beneath the Goblin Fort. Clear floor after floor of the King's goblins for gold - every run starts on floor 1. How deep can you go?
Items.Title: The Goblin Kingdom

Items.Text: Every 10th floor: Gorbag the Siegemaster, Nyxa the Hexblade, Grumhold the Iron Juggernaut, Zogra the Beastmistress and Mogrul the Goblin Emperor. Past floor 50 they come back stronger.
Items.Title: Five new bosses

Items.Text: Each Kingdom boss and the Warchief drops its own armor set, shield and weapon - with set perks like bombs, hexes, gores and crits.
Items.Title: New boss gear

Items.Text: Warband Raiders and Brutes, Kingdom Guards, Berserkers, Champions and Hex Shades - all in the Collection Book.
Items.Title: New goblins

Items.Text: A new Kingdom leaderboard in the Journal's Top Players tab, plus 11 new badges: one for each new boss and for reaching floors 10, 25, 50, 75 and 100.
Items.Title: Deepest Floor

Items.Text: A dwarf smith has set up shop in town, next to the Enchanter's Altar. Fortify your pickaxes, weapons, shields and armor with ore for permanent stat boosts.
Items.Title: Grimbold's Forge

Items.Text: Every item has 10 fortify levels. Stone adds +1% a level, Elderbloom adds +6.3%. Fill all 10, then reforge your weakest level with something better.
Items.Title: Better ore, bigger boost

Items.Text: Badges for every boss, every questline, the endgame ores, enchanting, the forge, pets and the Collection Book - plus combo badges for beating them all. Things you've already done count!
Items.Title: 36 new badges

Items.Text: Fortified gear shows its +level on its card in your Inventory.
Items.Title: Inventory

Items.Text: This window! Open it any time with the News button at the top of the screen.
Items.Title: What's New

Items.Text: The world-tree's roots, far to the west past the Broodhollow. New enemies, four new ores and a new questline: The Withering Root.
Items.Title: Rootdeep

Items.Text: Rootdeep's boss guards the Heartroot. Beat it for Elder Root gear.
Items.Title: Gnarlroot, the Elder Root

Items.Text: Four endgame raid bosses beside the Raid Gate: the Frost Wyrm, the Kraken, the Lich King and the Storm Titan - each with its own gear.
Items.Title: The Elder Gate

Items.Text: A giant centipede boss deep in the Broodhollow.
Items.Title: Vesskar the Thousand-Leg

Items.Text: Fill in every ore, creature, piece of gear and pet for gold and permanent perks.
Items.Title: Collection Book

Items.Text: Up to 4 pets out at once, and the Brood Egg with bug pets.
Items.Title: Pets

Items.Text: 40 more enchants, focus an enchant to boost its odds, and Quick and Auto roll.
Items.Title: Enchanting

Items.Text: A spider and ant nest past the Abyss, with the toughest rock in the game.
Items.Title: The Broodhollow

Items.Text: A new questline through the nest.
Items.Title: The Brood Awakens

Items.Text: Two new endgame pickaxes - ride an ant mound or walk on spider legs.
Items.Title: Swarmcaller & Broodmother

Items.Text: A venomous new weapon and a new armor set.
Items.Title: Widowfang & Broodguard

BroodQuestData.finished: The way is open, miner. Watch the widows' webs, and keep your shield up. And tell Old Tobias I sent you: he'll forge you something special now.
BroodQuestData.name: The Brood Awakens

steps.Title: Stray Clutches
steps.Lore: Eggs! Outside the hill! The workers only carry them out when the nest is overflowing. Four clutches have rolled loose: one by the old road, two around the foot of the hill, and one up by the crater. Bring them in before they hatch, and mind your fingers.

steps.Title: Thin the Void
steps.Lore: The eggs smell of the Void. The brood has been feeding on what leaks out of the Abyss, and that's what made them so big. Go back down and slay a hundred and fifty of those things. Starve the nest a little before you walk into it.

steps.Title: The Warden's Salve
steps.Lore: That barrier is pure brood venom, set hard. Nothing dissolves it but a salve of the rarest things under the earth. Thirty Dragonheart, twenty Abyssium, thirty Starmetal. Yes, I know how much that is.

steps.Title: The Heart That Feeds
steps.Lore: The leak has a source. Vor'Thalax. While that heart beats, the brood will never stop growing. I've been told it can't be done, so I'd like you to go and do it.

steps.Title: Into the Hill
steps.Lore: You did it? Truly? Then come here and take the salve. Once it touches the barrier there's no sealing that hill again. Are you ready?

BroodQuestData.intro: Forty years I've studied insects, and I have never seen ants the size of a cart. There's a whole brood in that hill, spiders and all, and it's growing. Help me find out why, and I'll get you through that barrier. Old Tobias has been itching to forge with their chitin, too.

VoidQuestData.finished: The seal knows your name now. Go. The Abyss is open to you, and Tobias will sell you his finest work.
VoidQuestData.name: Whispers of the Void

steps.Title: Echoes of the Void
steps.Lore: When the seal was forged, three shards of the Void were flung across the land. One fell into the deepest chamber of the Deep Mines, one beside the Eclipse Shrine, and one along the old road out here. Find them. They hum - listen for it.

steps.Title: Blood Offering
steps.Lore: The shards remember you now, but the Void is hungry. Feed it two hundred goblins. It does not care where they fall.

steps.Title: Tribute of the Deep
steps.Lore: The seal is stone, and stone answers to stone. Dig me forty Obsidian and fifteen Mythril from the Deep Mines and lay them at my feet.

steps.Title: The Dragon's Ember
steps.Lore: One last spark is needed - dragonfire. Ignaroth sleeps beyond the Raid Gate. Wake him, and bring down the beast.
steps.Goal: Defeat Ignaroth beyond the Raid Gate

steps.Title: The Rite of Passage
steps.Goal: Return to Morvane at the Abyss
steps.Lore: It is done. Come back to me at the edge of the Abyss, and I will speak your name to the seal.

VoidQuestData.intro: You hear it too, don't you? The hum beneath the mountain. The Abyss is sealed, miner, and it opens for no one the Void has not tasted. Walk the path I set you, and the seal will part - and old Tobias will finally forge for you.

SkyQuestData.finished: Ha! You made it up the ladder! The Sky Lift's yours now - step on it any time and it'll float you straight up to Skyreach. Go and get rich.
SkyQuestData.name: The Skyward Path

steps.Title: Storm Feathers
steps.Lore: The ladder only holds for those who carry the storm. The goblin archers at the fort to the south-west fletch their arrows with Storm Feathers - stolen from my ship! Get me twelve.
steps.Goal: Take Storm Feathers from Goblin Archers

steps.Title: Fort Breaker
steps.Lore: Those same goblins shot me out of the sky. Two hundred and fifty of them, and they'll think twice before aiming at an airship again.
steps.Goal: Defeat goblins at the Goblin Fort

steps.Title: Dragon's Thermals
steps.Lore: Up there the winds will tear you off the ladder. Learn to keep your feet the hard way - beat Ignaroth in his roost. Three times.

steps.Title: Ballast of the Earth
steps.Lore: I need ballast to raise the Sky Lift once you're up: good heavy ore from the ground. Sixty Gold Bars, forty Crystal, twenty-five Rubies and fifteen Mythril.
steps.Goal: Bring Gale 60 Gold Bars, 40 Crystal, 25 Ruby and 15 Mythril

steps.Title: The Long Climb
steps.Goal: Climb the Sky Ladder to Skyreach
steps.Lore: Now climb. The Sky Ladder winds all the way up to Skyreach. Rest on the glowing ledges - if you fall, you'll wake on the last one you reached. Reach the top and the island is yours.

SkyQuestData.intro: Ahoy, groundling! See that island up in the clouds? Skyreach. Richest ore you'll ever swing a pick at - Skysilver, Sunpearl, Aetherium. My ship went down before I could get back to it. Help an old captain out and I'll show you the way up... but it's no stroll.

QuestData.finished: You have done what none before you could. Eclipsar's blessing is yours - Whiskers will part with the Eclipse Pickaxe and armor now.
QuestData.name: The Eclipse Prophecy

steps.Title: Trial of Strength
steps.Lore: The gods do not listen to the weak. Thin the goblin hordes of the Deep Mines - one hundred and fifty of them.

steps.Title: Trial of Toil
steps.Lore: Strength without patience is nothing. Break three hundred ore nodes, and let the mountain know your name.

steps.Title: Trial of Valor
steps.Lore: Now face the terrors beyond the Raid Gate. Topple the Goblin King, the Colossus and Ignaroth - all three.

steps.Title: Trial of the Sun
steps.Lore: The Sun Gate stands open for you. Its warden, Solarius, burns all who are unworthy. Do not stand where the light falls.
steps.Goal: Defeat Solarius at the Sun Gate

steps.Title: Trial of the Moon
steps.Lore: Through the Moon Gate waits Nocturne, who strikes from the shadows and hides behind her shades. Break her veil.
steps.Goal: Defeat Nocturne at the Moon Gate

steps.Title: The Eclipse
steps.Lore: It is time. Step through the Eclipse Gate and face Eclipsar, who is both the day and the night. When the sky goes dark, find the light - or perish.
steps.Goal: Defeat Eclipsar, God of the Sun and Moon

QuestData.intro: Miner... the sun and moon have shown me your face. Long ago their god forged a pickaxe of pure eclipse. Prove yourself through six trials and it may be yours.

RootQuestData.finished: The whole tree is open to you now. Mind the Moss Golems in the Grove; they don't feel pain. And Old Tobias has been asking about heartwood. Go and see him.
RootQuestData.name: The Withering Root

steps.Title: The Lost Seeds
steps.Lore: The great tree dropped its last seeds the night it died, and the wind scattered them. One lies north among the roots, one south, one round the far side, and one by the road you walked in on. Bring them to me. With them in my hand, the roots at the gate will remember me and let us pass.

steps.Title: Thin the Rootlings
steps.Lore: The way is open, but only partway. Those twig-things in the Mossway are the tree's rot, walking. Every one you cut down is a little less blight in the roots. A hundred and fifty should do it. The Grove and the Heart stay shut until the rot is beaten back.

steps.Title: Cleanse the Sap Pools
steps.Lore: The tree still bleeds sap into three pools past the Mossway, and the blight has turned them black. Kneel at each one and stir in a seed. Watch out for the Thornspitters; they guard the pools like they own them.

steps.Title: The Root's Offering
steps.Lore: The deep roots won't open for a stranger. They want something of themselves given back: sap gone to stone, silver drawn up from the dark, and a little of the heartwood itself. Thirty, twenty and five. The tree keeps count.

steps.Title: Wake the Heartroot
steps.Lore: Can you feel it? The pools run gold again, and something deep in the stump has started to beat. Come, give me your hand. The Grove and the Heartroot will open, and whatever lives at the heart of the tree will know we're coming.

RootQuestData.intro: I tended this tree for three hundred years, and now look at it. Dead, and rotting from the roots up. Something is still alive in there, feeding on it. Help me reach the heart, and I'll see that Old Tobias gets wood and ore no forge has ever touched.

TreeQuestData.name: The Waking Tree
TreeQuestData.intro: Fennick tends the roots, and I tend the rest. Always have. I was asleep in a knot of bark for a hundred years, until you woke the Heartroot. Now the old girl wants to grow again, and I could use a strong pair of hands.
TreeQuestData.finished: There she is, as green as the day I planted her. The Hollow and the Hive are yours to roam. Mind the bees, they've got long memories.

steps.Title: Feed the Roots
steps.Goal: Bring 40 Sapstone, 30 Rootsilver, 10 Heartwood and 3 Elderbloom
steps.Lore: See that green shoot up on the stump? The old tree isn't dead after all, it's starving. Bring me ore from its own roots and I'll work it into the soil. Feed it well, and it'll grow fast enough to make your head spin.

steps.Title: Clear the Hollow
steps.Goal: Slay Barkbeetles in the Heartwood Hollow
steps.Lore: Ha! Look at her go! The trunk's grown right over the old stump, and there's a hollow in her base. Climb the root stair. Trouble is, beetles got in before we did. They chew the heartwood, and the tree can't grow any more while they're in there. Thin them out.

steps.Title: Amber Tears
steps.Goal: Gather the 5 amber tears in the Hollow
steps.Lore: When a tree is hurt, it weeps amber. There are five big tears in the Hollow, glowing where the beetles chewed. Gather them all and bring the tree's pain back to me. I'll press it into the roots, and she'll reach for the sky.

steps.Title: Smoke the Hive
steps.Goal: Slay Honey Drones in the Beehive
steps.Lore: Well, I didn't plan on that. The bees from the Broodhollow have built a hive on her biggest branch, and those are no honeybees, they're the size of a pony. Climb the trunk, walk the branch, and knock that swarm back before they strip her bare.

steps.Title: Wake the Crown
steps.Lore: Do you hear that? The whole tree is humming. She's ready. Give me your hand, and we'll wake the crown together, the way it was before the rot.

Gale Burst.Description: A roaring gust blasts everything in front of you away for 200% damage.

Poison Cloud.Description: A choking green cloud lingers for 6 seconds, poisoning foes inside for 50% damage every half second.

Archmage's Wrath.Description: Channel raw arcane power into a pillar from the sky: 3000% damage in a vast blast, stunning foes for 3 seconds.

Healing Light.Description: A warm golden light restores 35% of your health.

Will-o'-Wisps.Description: Three wisps circle you for 12 seconds, each zapping a nearby foe for 90% damage.

Meteor.Description: Call a meteor down from the sky: 1000% damage in a huge blast, and the ground burns.

Thunderstorm.Description: A storm gathers over you: 10 lightning bolts strike foes within 40 studs for 600% damage each.

Magic Missile.Description: Three homing bolts of arcane light seek out the nearest foes for 150% damage each.

Phoenix Form.Description: Burst into phoenix flame (800% damage), then burn everything within 10 studs and heal 3% a second for 10 seconds.

Time Warp.Description: Bend time: every foe within 35 studs crawls at half speed for 6 seconds while you move 50% faster.

Starfall.Description: The heavens open: 24 falling stars rain down over 3 seconds, each blasting foes for 600%.

Stone Skin.Description: Your skin hardens to stone: take 50% less damage for 8 seconds.

Ice Nova.Description: A ring of ice explodes out from you for 400% damage, freezing foes solid for 2.5 seconds.

Black Hole.Description: Tear open a black hole that drags foes in for 4 seconds (100% damage 4 times a second), then collapses for 1000%.

Frost Shard.Description: A shard of ice shatters for 250% damage and chills foes to half speed for 3 seconds.

Firebolt.Description: Hurl a fireball that explodes for 300% damage and sets foes burning.

Soul Drain.Description: Tether up to 3 nearby foes and drain them for 3 seconds (80% damage 4 times a second), healing you for 40% of it.

Arcane Blink.Description: Vanish and reappear up to 35 studs away in a burst of arcane force (200% damage).

Chain Lightning.Description: Lightning leaps between up to 6 foes, striking each for 250% damage.

Wall of Fire.Description: Raise a wall of roaring flame for 8 seconds; foes in it burn for 80% damage every half second.
